Group rides in Michigan

14 recurring group rides around Michigan: 7 social, 6 road, 3 mountain bike. 11 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride in Detroit — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? KBC Monday Night Ride runs up to eight groups, 12–13 mph through 19–21 mph.
